title: Control Board Fault
fullDescription: F0 indicates a generic control board error on Amana ovens. Power cycle first, then replace board.

title: EEPROM Error
fullDescription: F1 indicates EEPROM memory fault in the control. Replace board.

title: Over Temperature
fullDescription: F2 means oven temperature too high. Could be stuck relay or sensor.

title: Open Sensor
fullDescription: F3 means RTD sensor is open. Replace sensor.

title: Shorted Sensor
fullDescription: F4 means RTD sensor shorted. Replace sensor.

title: Watchdog Fault
fullDescription: F5 indicates watchdog fault in control. Reset or replace.

title: Stuck Key
fullDescription: F7 means a key on the touchpad is stuck or keypad failed.

title: A/D Conversion Fault
fullDescription: F8 means analog to digital conversion failure in control. Replace EOC.

title: Door Latch Fault
fullDescription: F9 indicates the door latch motor or switch is not working correctly.

title: Runaway Temperature
fullDescription: F10 indicates runaway temperature. Serious fault requiring immediate attention.
